This smartphone UI screen is prompting the user to choose an application to complete an action. The background displays a "Keep Calm" poster. The prompt at the bottom of the screen offers two options for completing the action using a music application. The two options are:

1. Music (com.musicplayer.music)
2. Music (com.android.music)
